info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Mutual Fund Administration API
info.description: The Mutual Fund Administration API facilitates management and administrative operations associated with mutual funds. This API allows financial institutions to perform critical tasks such as processing transactions, managing investor portfolios, and handling fund distributions. Typical consumers include banks, asset management companies, and financial service providers looking to streamline their mutual fund operations. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their service offerings and improve operational efficiency in fund management.

post.summary: Create a new mutual fund administration operation.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new mutual fund administration operation, enabling the management of mutual fund-related activities effectively. Ensure that you provide all the necessary details in the request body for successful operation creation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate mutual fund administration operations. It should contain all necessary details required to process the request according to the defined schema.
